pages.text: Kilele Telecom (SYN), ticker KIL8, is listed on the SYN Securities Exchange in the telecom sector. The ticker of Kilele Telecom (SYN) on the exchange is KIL8. Kilele Telecom (SYN) declared a dividend of SYN Sh 3.29 per share for the year ended 31 December 2025. Net profit of Kilele Telecom (SYN) for 2025 was SYN Sh 6,975 million. The closing price of KIL8 on 2026-09-30 was SYN Sh 45.66.

Kilele Telecom (SYN) has 3,299 million shares in issue. This listing summary is published by the SYN Securities Exchange from company filings and is not a recommendation to buy or sell. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
